recipes.name: Bell Peppers and Beef inspired by Cowboy Bebop
ingredients: 2 Longhorn peppers, thinly sliced on a diagonal
2 cornstarch slurry (1 tbsp cornstarch + tbsp chicken stock)
instructions: For the Stir Fry Sauce
In a small bowl, combine oyster sauce, cornstarch, Shaoxing rice wine, and soy sauce. Set aside. - 3 tbsp oyster sauce - ½ tbsp cornstarch - 2 tsp Shaoxing rice wine - 1 tbsp soy sauce
For the Mushroom Stir Fry
Slice the bell peppers and mushrooms into thin strips. - 8 oz mushrooms sliced - 3 bell peppers thinly sliced
Mince the garlic cloves. - 2 cloves garlic minced
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium high heat. - 2 tbsp vegetable oil
Once the oil is smoking, add the mushrooms and a pinch of salt. Stir-fry until the mushrooms are browned. - 8 oz mushrooms sliced
Add sesame oil, stir, and then remove the mushrooms from the pan. - 1 tbsp sesame oil
In the same pan, reset with the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil, followed by the bell peppers. Stir-fry until softened. - 2 tsp Shaoxing rice wine - 3 bell peppers thinly sliced

Add the minced garlic and the remaining 1/2 tbsp sesame oil, stir for a few seconds, then return the mushrooms to the pan. Be careful not to burn the garlic. - 2 cloves garlic minced - 1 tbsp sesame oil
Sprinkle with sugar and pour in the prepared stir-fry sauce. Cook until everything is well-coated and heated through. - 1 tsp sugar
Serve hot. - salt to taste
For the Stir Fry Sauce
In a small bowl, combine oyster sauce, cornstarch, Shaoxing rice wine, and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Set aside. - 3 tbsp oyster sauce - ½ tbsp cornstarch - 2 tsp Shaoxing cooking wine - 1 tbsp soy sauce
For the Beef Stir Fry
Slice the bell peppers and flank steak into thin strips. - 3 bell peppers thinly sliced - ½ lb flank steak thinly sliced
Mince the garlic cloves. - 2 cloves of garlic minced
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium high heat. - 2 tbsp vegetable oil
Add the sliced beef and stir-fry getting the steam out until the beef is just cooked. - ½ lb flank steak thinly sliced
Remove the beef and set aside.
In the same pan, reset with the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil, followed by the bell peppers. Stir-fry until lightly colored and brown. - 2 tbsp vegetable oil - 3 bell peppers thinly sliced
Add the minced garlic and stir briefly. - 2 cloves of garlic minced
Return the beef to the pan, add sugar, and pour in the prepared stir fry sauce. Cook until everything is well-coated and heated through. - ½ lb flank steak thinly sliced - 1 tsp sugar
Salt to taste. Serve hot.
For the Chun Jiao Rou Tiao
Slice the flank steak into very thin strips. - ½ flank steak thinly sliced
Slice the Longhorn peppers on a diagonal into very thin strips. - 2 Longhorn peppers thinly sliced on a diagonal
Slice garlic cloves. - 2 cloves garlic sliced
In a small mixing bowl, combine 1 tbsp cornstarch with 1 tbsp chicken stock to make cornstarch slurry. Set aside. - 2 cornstarch slurry (1 tbsp cornstarch + tbsp chicken stock)
In a large mixing bowl, season the beef strips with salt, white pepper, and chicken bouillon powder. - ½ flank steak thinly sliced - 1 tsp salt - ½ tsp white pepper - chicken bouillon powder

Add soy sauce, sesame oil, Shaoxing cooking wine, egg white, and cornstarch to the beef mixture. Mix vigorously with chopsticks until the beef is well-coated and the mixture is aerated. - 1 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp sesame oil - 2 tsp Shaoxing cooking wine - 1 egg white - 1 tbsp cornstarch
Heat vegetable oil in the wok over high heat until smoking. - ¼ cup vegetable oil
Add the Longhorn peppers and stir-fry briefly until fragrant. Remove and set aside. - 2 Longhorn peppers thinly sliced on a diagonal
Reset the pan with more vegetable oil and carefully add the beef strips, shallow frying until they form a crust. Remove and drain. - ¼ cup vegetable oil - ½ flank steak thinly sliced
Reuse flavored oil to fry garlic slices. - 2 cloves garlic sliced
Return the beef and peppers to the pan, stirring everything together. - ½ flank steak thinly sliced - 2 Longhorn peppers thinly sliced on a diagonal
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and pour in the cornstarch slurry, stirring quickly to form a sauce. - 1 tbsp sesame seeds - 2 cornstarch slurry (1 tbsp cornstarch + tbsp chicken stock)
Finish with a drizzle of sesame oil and serve hot. - 1 tbsp sesame oil
